node.statement: Induction on the finite number q of basis projections, composing the step bijection with the preceding one and using Q_[1,q]=w(I_C), yields S_{P_j,Q}->direct-sum_{k=1}^q S_{P_j,Q_k}. A finite composition/direct sum of bounded linear bijections is a bounded linear bijection.
